tools.name: rufi.get_overview
tools.description: The active person's health record in Rufi at a glance: their name, how many documents and reports they have, and their current test results exactly as printed (test, value, unit, reference range, flag, method or context, measured date at the precision known). At most 20 results, newest measured first, undated last. An amended result replaces the one it corrects and says "amended": true. Takes no input: Rufi chooses the person, not you.

tools.name: rufi.read_conversation
tools.description: Earlier parts of this conversation, newest first. Each entry's kind is "message" (the user's), "steer" (the user's, sent while you were replying), "reply" (yours) or "activity" (one thing you did: a title and one short detail, never its output). At most 50 entries a page; pass the page's next_before to read further back. Rufi chooses the conversation, not you.

before.description: Read entries before this position: the `next_before` of the previous page.

limit.description: How many entries, 1 to 50; 20 when left out.
